Hi Sophia —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the MAP I promised to share. Attached is a one-page MAP draft that lays out milestones, owners, and dependencies for the vendor onboarding / procurement lane (Ariba/Coupa setup, vendor forms, W-9, banking details).

Key milestones (high level):
- Ariba/Coupa supplier setup requested 
  Owner: Acme Procurement (procurement@acmeplatforms.com) / Redwood (Rafael)
  Dependency: completed Vendor Information Form + legal review
  Target completion: 2026-10-25
- Vendor forms & W-9 submitted
  Owner: Acme (Sophia)
  Dependency: internal finance signoff; Redwood to supply template/example
  Target completion: 2026-10-20
- Banking details / ACH setup completed
  Owner: Acme Finance / Redwood Finance (Marissa)
  Target completion: 2026-10-27
- First invoice/payment terms finalized
  Owner: Redwood Sales + Acme Procurement
  Target completion: 2026-10-28

Open items for your team: vendor onboarding contact (Procurement system admin for Ariba/Coupa), any preferred vendor codes, and whether Acme requires a specific supplier questionnaire.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm who will own the Ariba/Coupa supplier request and reply with contact.
2) Fill the attached Vendor Information Form and send back to procurement@acmeplatforms.com and cc me.
3) If you prefer, I can open the supplier request from Redwood’s side once we have the completed form and W-9.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_Draft_Acme_20261015.pdf, Vendor_Information_Form_Acme.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Rafael Mendes

Thanks Rafael — this is helpful. I shared the MAP with our procurement team (cc'ed). A few notes from procurement:
- We own the Ariba supplier creation but will need the completed vendor form + W-9 attached to the supplier request; that aligns with your doc.
- Our supplier admin (Karen Lee) is the Ariba system contact — I can loop her in once we have the files.
- We do require a short supplier questionnaire for security posture if the contract value exceeds $100k; looks like we are still in evaluation on that.

Attached is our internal procurement checklist and a PDF of the W-9. I completed the Vendor Information Form with basic details — see attached draft (we left banking empty until your finance team confirms preferred ACH format).

Attachments: Vendor_Information_Form_Acme.pdf, W-9_Acme_Platforms.pdf

Can you confirm whether Redwood will: 1) initiate the Ariba request from your side after we send back the completed form, or 2) require us to open the supplier request in our Ariba instance? Also confirm who from Redwood Finance (name/email) we should share banking instructions with.

Best,

Thanks Sophia — helpful. Quick internal note: Marissa (Finance) will own banking/ACH onboarding. Marissa — can you confirm Redwood's preferred ACH instructions format and whether we can supply a bank letter?

To Sophia's question: Redwood can open the supplier request from our side (we've done this successfully with large procurement systems) once Acme confirms that approach. If Acme prefers to open the Ariba ticket internally, that's fine too — either way, we need the completed vendor form + W-9.

Updated MAP actions (small edits):
- Redwood to initiate Ariba request OR provide completed attachments to Acme procurement (mutually agreed)
- Redwood Finance (Marissa) to provide ACH template by 2026-10-19
- Target close: vendor onboarding completed and supplier code issued by 2026-10-28 (to enable first invoice in November)

I'll wait for Marissa's confirmation and Sophia's sign-off on who will open the supplier request.
